content.text: Since Kubernetes environments have only been widely used in the market for about the last 2-3 years, problems often arise where a systematic environment is not yet in place, leading to massive resource consumption during use and making security management difficult.

To solve this, QueryPie stepped up! In Episode 4, we explored how to maintain a robust security environment in Kubernetes using QueryPie's Kubernetes access control solution, 'QueryPie KAC (Kubernetes Access Controller)'.
How to efficiently manage clusters in a Kubernetes environment
Granular resource access management (Namespace, Pods, Deployments, Replica Sets)
'QueryPie KAC' enables efficient security management even in Kubernetes environments. Check out the detailed usage on [Ch. QueryPie: 3-Step Side Kick]!
